title: Checks
description: What a visit is worth. A check is quantity times the dish's current price over the submitted pre-order items of a confirmed booking; the time axis is the booking's start in Asia/Tbilisi.

list.name: location
list.label: Location
list.query: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at
list.definition: SELECT address AS __text, id AS __value FROM locations ORDER BY created_at

panels.title: Average check per booking and per person
panels.description: Average over confirmed bookings with a submitted pre-order; per person divides each check by the party size.

targets.rawSql:
WITH checks AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.starts_at, b.party_size, t.location_id,
         sum(i.quantity * d.price_cents) / 100.0 AS amount
  FROM preorder_items i
  JOIN booking_participants p ON p.id = i.participant_id
  JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = i.dish_id
  WHERE i.state = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
  GROUP BY b.id, t.location_id
)
SELECT avg(amount)::float AS "Per booking",
       avg(amount / party_size)::float AS "Per person"
FROM checks

panels.title: Check by category
panels.description: The average check split by dish category: the category's money over the number of checks.

targets.rawSql:
WITH lines AS (
  SELECT b.id AS booking_id, d.category, i.quantity * d.price_cents / 100.0 AS amount
  FROM preorder_items i
  JOIN booking_participants p ON p.id = i.participant_id
  JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = i.dish_id
  WHERE i.state = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
)
SELECT CASE category
         WHEN 'APPETIZER' THEN 'Appetizers'
         WHEN 'MAIN_COURSE' THEN 'Main courses'
         WHEN 'DESSERT' THEN 'Desserts'
       END AS "Category",
       (sum(amount) / (SELECT count(DISTINCT booking_id) FROM lines))::float AS "Average per check"
FROM lines
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Check by location and weekday
panels.description: Average check per booking by the weekday the booking starts, for each location.

targets.rawSql:
WITH checks AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.starts_at, b.party_size, t.location_id,
         sum(i.quantity * d.price_cents) / 100.0 AS amount
  FROM preorder_items i
  JOIN booking_participants p ON p.id = i.participant_id
  JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = i.dish_id
  WHERE i.state = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
  GROUP BY b.id, t.location_id
)
SELECT (ARRAY['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'])[w.weekday] AS weekday, l.address AS location, avg(c.amount)::float AS average_check
FROM generate_series(1, 7) AS w (weekday)
CROSS JOIN locations l
LEFT JOIN checks c ON c.location_id = l.id
  AND extract(isodow FROM c.starts_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tbilisi') = w.weekday
WHERE l.id IN ($location)
GROUP BY w.weekday, l.id
ORDER BY w.weekday, l.created_at

panels.title: Revenue per day
panels.description: Sum of the checks by the day the booking starts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH checks AS (
  SELECT b.id, b.starts_at, b.party_size, t.location_id,
         sum(i.quantity * d.price_cents) / 100.0 AS amount
  FROM preorder_items i
  JOIN booking_participants p ON p.id = i.participant_id
  JOIN bookings b ON b.id = p.booking_id
  JOIN dining_tables t ON t.id = b.table_id
  JOIN dishes d ON d.id = i.dish_id
  WHERE i.state = 'SUBMITTED'
    AND $__timeFilter(b.starts_at)
    AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED'
    AND t.location_id IN ($location)
  GROUP BY b.id, t.location_id
)
SELECT date_trunc('day', starts_at, 'Asia/Tbilisi') AS time, sum(amount)::float AS "Revenue"
FROM checks
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
